Small-scale test for the next campaign

Local estimate only; no campaigns are created and no money is spent.
Test groupSearch intent and keyword directionSuggested daily capLanding page and primary action

The 60% / 40% split is a starting point for manual review. Verify conversion tracking before counting test days. If the account cap remains ¥50/day, combined campaign budgets should stay within that cap. Historical CPC is for estimation only; future prices and click volumes may differ.

How to decide whether to continue

Prioritise qualified leads and cost per qualified lead; CTA clicks are supporting signals. Around 20 clicks or ¥50 of spend without a verified lead should trigger a manual review of intent, landing page and tracking, not an automatic pause. Without lead feedback, do not raise bids solely for position or switch straight to conversion-based bidding. Keep device, region and time comparisons until qualified-lead evidence supports changes.

Collection status

How to read this report

Keywords vs search terms
Keywords are the terms you target. Search terms are what users actually type. One keyword can trigger many search terms, and one search term can be triggered by multiple keywords.
What does zero conversions mean?
It only confirms that the Baidu API returned no conversions under the selected definition. It does not prove that there were no actual enquiries. Check website forms, phone records, CRM and conversion tracking.
Current inventory vs historical performance
Keyword status, quality, bids and campaign pause status come from the latest inventory snapshot. Impressions, clicks and spend come from the selected historical period. Deleted keywords retain their historical performance records.
Missing vs zero
A reported value of zero is shown as 0. A keyword present in the inventory but absent from the report is shown as —, keeping missing records distinct from confirmed zeroes.
How ratios are calculated
CTR = total clicks ÷ total impressions. CPC = total spend ÷ total clicks. Ratios are calculated from totals, not by averaging daily ratios. Reports show different views of the same spend; do not add them together.
Time and updates
Dates use Beijing time. GitHub Actions is scheduled at 09:00 daily to collect through the previous day and refresh the last 7 days. Scheduling may be delayed; this Mac does not need to be running. This page shows the latest successfully published snapshot. Check the last run time and refresh the report.
